publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: Thirty updates do not mean thirty camera images
record.method: Counter analysis of the accepted preview baseline
record.observation: The baseline accepted 417 submissions and dropped 1,138 of 1,555, a 73.18% admission-drop rate. The renderer selected 414 distinct images at 7.904/s while the panel-update counter reported 30.263/s.
record.limits: These are counters from one recorded window. They do not directly measure physical scanout timing or end-to-end camera latency. The source revision contains a larger-queue candidate, but its physical performance comparison was still pending at this publication snapshot.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: Thirty updates do not mean thirty camera images
rows: Updates may reuse a camera image

exhibits.interpretation: Different counters describe different pipeline boundaries. The trace supports investigating queue retirement; it does not establish a 30 fps viewfinder.
